title: General chemistry I
stage: College neuroscience and cognitive science degree
audience: a college student in a neuroscience, cognitive science, psychology or biology degree program, or an adult studying the same material on their own
purpose: Use atomic structure, the mole and stoichiometry, aqueous reactions, gas laws, thermochemistry, electron configurations, periodic trends, bonding, molecular shape, intermolecular forces and solutions.

blocks.deliverable: Solve multistep stoichiometry with a limiting reagent.
Use the ideal gas law and partial pressures for gases in blood and air.
Apply Hess's law and write electron configurations.
Week 7 midterm; draw Lewis structures with formal charges.
Predict shape and polarity with VSEPR theory.
Rank boiling points and compute molarity, molality and osmolarity.
Submit the project; take an unseen 120 minute final in week 14.

project: Solution-preparation plan: compute the masses and dilutions for saline and dextrose solutions, including the osmolarity of 0.9% saline, and check each concentration.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
